summary.headline: TARIL Q1 FY27 standalone revenue rose 10% YoY to INR559 crores, with EBITDA margin at 15.6%, as Changodar under-utilisation weighed on sequential growth.
summary.overview: Standalone revenue from operations was INR559 crores (+10% YoY) with EBITDA of INR87 crores (15.6% margin) and PAT of INR50 crores (8.9% margin). Consolidated revenue was INR572 crores, EBITDA INR110 crores (19.2%) and PAT INR64 crores. Sequentially growth slowed because Changodar capacity was reduced by expansion work, and management guides to recovery from August 2026 and normalisation from Q3 FY27. Order inflow was INR2,114 crores (+218% YoY) and the unexecuted order book reached INR6,630 crores (+26% YoY), including a PGCIL ultra-mega order above INR1,000 crores.

financial_highlights.change: Down sequentially, per management, due to Changodar utilisation

financial_highlights.value: around INR424 crores; debt-to-equity about 0.3x; debt-to-EBITDA about 1.1x

segments.name: Transformers (standalone, Changodar plant)
segments.commentary: Changodar utilisation is low due to expansion work; management says it will be 60-65% in FY27 and 80-85% in FY28. Changodar expansion capex is about INR150 crores, with completion expected by August 2026.

segments.name: Transformers (standalone, Moraiya plant)
segments.commentary: Utilisation was 57% per the presentation; management says it is running at about 60-65% and targets 80-85% going forward, with the Moraiya expansion scheduled for Q3 2027.

segments.name: Transformers (standalone, Odhav plant)
segments.commentary: Utilisation was shown at 100% in the presentation, per the analyst's reading of the utilisation chart.

segments.name: Subsidiaries (consolidated)
segments.commentary: Consolidated EBITDA margin of 19.2% against 15.6% standalone, which management attributes to integrated operations and subsidiary contribution.

guidance_outlook: FY27 guidance: 25% revenue growth, 16% EBITDA margin (standalone, including other income) and PAT margin of 9-10%.
Consolidated EBITDA margin for FY27 could be around 20-21% or higher, per the CFO; subsidiaries may add about 100 bps.
Management targets about 30% growth in both domestic and export order inflow in FY27; export revenue to remain at 10-15% of business.
Revenue ambition of about $1 billion by FY29, which the CFO re-based to about INR8,000 crores because of a different rupee rate; FY28 guidance to be given in Q4 FY27.
Medium-term annual revenue capacity of INR5,000-6,000 crores from existing and expanded capacity; backward integration adds INR800-1,000 crores of third-party sales in phase two.
Backward integration is expected to add 200-300 bps to margins, starting from FY28.
Working capital target of 120-130 days on average, and inventory reduction expected from Q4 FY28.
capex_capacity: Existing transformer manufacturing capacity is 75,000 MVA+ across plants; the immediate priority is utilisation and throughput, not new transformer capacity.
CTC facility (8,000 MTPA Phase I; 24,000 MTPA Phase II) targeted for commissioning by Q2 FY27.

Pressboard and insulation facility (5,000 MTPA Phase I; 10,000 MTPA Phase II) targeted for Q3 FY27; RIP bushings (3,000 units p.a. Phase I; 6,000 Phase II) targeted for Q4 FY27; fabrication (25,000 MTPA Phase I; 50,000 MTPA Phase II) targeted for Q1 FY28. CRGO processing facility is already operational.
Backward integration is expected to cover 80-85% of raw material in-house; total investment INR900-1,000 crores, with finance leasing of about INR500 crores after leasing of plant machinery.
Raw material procurement has been secured up to December 2026, when backward integration facilities are expected to be running.
demand_pricing: Order book is executable over 18-24 months; the PGCIL ultra-mega order (above INR1,000 crores, 30 months) is an exception, per management.
Inquiries under negotiation total about INR23,000 crores, with an 80% domestic and 20% export mix; the historical win ratio is 10-15%.
Q1 orders: PGCIL above INR1,000 crores; GETCO about INR228 crores; RRVPNL INR175 crores; US export order from PDC AK LPIV, LLC about INR150 crores.
All Indian tenders are quoted on an L1 basis; management expects more PGCIL inquiries under negotiation.
Price variation clauses protect margins, per management; the company has also stocked raw materials to hedge geopolitical risk.
Q1 mix was heavy in 220 kV, 400 kV and 765 kV ratings because of Changodar constraints; mix is expected to spread across all ratings by end-August 2026.

qa_highlights.question: Is the Q1 revenue slowdown due to supply chain or geopolitical issues?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO attributed it to lower Changodar utilisation, not supply; raw material is covered up to December 2026, so geopolitics is not affecting raw material much.

qa_highlights.question: Why did other expenses fall to about 12% of sales?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said there is no one-off; other expenses were about INR66 crores vs INR69.74 crores last year, so there is no major reduction.

qa_highlights.question: Is the 16% EBITDA margin guidance standalone or consolidated, and does it include other income?
qa_highlights.answer: 16% is standalone at transformer level and includes other income; consolidated margin (19% in Q1) is higher, and the CFO guided consolidated FY27 margin to around 20-21%.

qa_highlights.question: Is the $1 billion revenue target still valid, and how does it reconcile with 25% growth?
qa_highlights.answer: Target re-based to about INR8,000 crores by FY29 (from INR9,600 crores at old rupee rate), from INR5,000-6,000 crores capacity plus INR800-1,000 crores third-party backward integration sales.

qa_highlights.question: Inventory build-up and debt: how will working capital and capex be funded?
qa_highlights.answer: Inventory is high as a hedge until backward integration is running; inventory reduction starts from Q4 FY28. Management says no increase in debt planned, with capex funded by cash, QIP balance of about INR145 crores, leasing (about INR500 crores) and internal accruals.

qa_highlights.question: What is the HVDC timeline?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said 9 months are needed to complete repair work on HVDC, after which PGCIL would empanel the company for a first trial order; full HVDC manufacturing is 15-16 months away.

qa_highlights.question: Will Changodar utilisation normalise, and what about Moraiya at 57%?
qa_highlights.answer: Changodar is expected at 60-65% in FY27 and 80-85% in FY28; Moraiya at 60-65% (57% per chart) is expected to reach 80-85% after Q3, with raw material protection through December.

risks_watch: Changodar ramp-up: utilisation at 60-65% through FY27; the August 2026 start and Q3 FY27 stabilisation are key checkpoints.
Backward integration timelines: CTC (Q2 FY27), pressboard (Q3 FY27), bushings (Q4 FY27) and fabrication (Q1 FY28) are at risk from delays such as the earlier Changodar slippage.
Working capital and leverage: NWC of about 170 days, high inventory, borrowings rising from FY25; management targets 120-130 days.
CRGO steel anti-dumping investigation by DGTR may raise raw material costs; management has not quantified impact.
Geopolitical risk to raw material supply and execution beyond December 2026.
Margin sustainability in FY27 at 16% standalone if mix shifts toward lower-rated transformers as Changodar recovers, per analyst question; management said no risk.
summary.management_tone: Confident on the medium-term outlook and order book, but defensive on the Q1 sequential slowdown and reluctant to quantify the Changodar, Moraiya and CRGO impacts. Several answers were repetitive or unquantified, and the $1 billion target was revised to INR8,000 crores without a clear bridge.
key_quotes: We are committed to providing only those guidance parameters that we are confident of achieving, going forward, our focus is firmly on delivering on our commitments.
The impact was purely project related temporary in nature.
Importantly this does not reflect any weakness in demand or order inflow or execution capability.

growth.why: Management guides 25% FY27 revenue growth and 16% standalone EBITDA margin, backed by an unexecuted order book of INR6,630 crores (+26% YoY) and Changodar/backward-integration capacity coming online from Q2 FY27 to Q1 FY28, though Changodar commissioning has been delayed and Moraiya runs at about 62.5%.
